segments.description: Sells Franklin Covey's leadership and performance-improvement solutions, including the AAP subscription, to corporations, governments, and not-for-profits in North America.
segments.evidence: The Enterprise Division consists of our North America, International Direct Office, and International Licensee segments and is focused on selling our solutions to corporations, governments, not-for-profits, and other related organizations.

segments.name: International direct offices
products: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
segments.description: Delivers Franklin Covey's enterprise solutions through wholly owned subsidiaries serving clients in Europe, Asia, and Australia.
segments.evidence: operate wholly owned subsidiaries that serve clients in Austria, Australia, China, France, Germany, Ireland, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.

segments.name: International licensees
products: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
segments.evidence: we may contract with independent licensee partners who deliver our content and provide services in approximately 150 other countries and territories around the world.

segments.name: Education Division
segments.description: Helps educational institutions build leadership cultures and improve student performance through the Leader in Me program and related coaching.
segments.evidence: In our Education Division, we offer the Leader in Me membership, which provides access to the Leader in Me online service, and authorizes Education clients to use Franklin Covey's proprietary intellectual property.

revenueModel.text: Organizations and educational institutions pay subscription fees for the All Access Pass and Leader in Me membership, plus fees for consulting, coaching, training, and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: FranklinCovey solutions are delivered as a combination of subscription-based access to proprietary content, implementation tools, assessments, and expert consulting and advisory services to help clients engage and align their people around their desired outcomes.

changes.text: In early fiscal 2025, the company opened a new direct office in France, converting operations from a licensee partnership to direct ownership.
changes.evidence: In early fiscal 2025, we opened a new direct office operation in France, which was previously served by a licensee partner.
